items.title: Security Metrics and Reporting to Management
items.summary: Focuses on selecting metrics and reporting security performance to leadership.
objectives: Communicate risk and performance to management

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: Focuses on selecting metrics and reporting security performance to leadership. This lesson focuses on practical understanding, decision-making and evidence-based GRC practice.
bullets: Communicate risk and performance to management

sections.heading: Key concepts
sections.body: Core concepts for security metrics and reporting to management are explained in plain language, with emphasis on roles, controls, risks and expected outcomes in an enterprise context.

sections.heading: Application
sections.body: Learners should be able to apply the concepts to realistic scenarios, justify decisions, and recognise common gaps or weaknesses.

examples.title: Applying Security Metrics and Reporting to Management
examples.context: A team must address security metrics and reporting to management in a business scenario with limited time and resources.
examples.outcome: A risk-informed, documented decision with clear ownership and follow-up actions.

practicalExercise.title: Exercise: Security Metrics and Reporting to Management
practicalExercise.brief: Apply the lesson to a fictional organisation facing challenges related to security metrics and reporting to management.
practicalExercise.deliverable: A short action plan with rationale.
